definition: Food assistance, food security analysis, and agriculture, livestock and fisheries programming.
includes: food distribution; food security assessments and IPC analysis; seeds and tools; pastoralism; veterinary; fisheries
excludes: malnutrition treatment (Nutrition); enterprise and market systems (Markets & value chains)

definition: Prevention and treatment of malnutrition.
includes: CMAM; infant and young child feeding; micronutrients; nutrition surveys (SMART)
excludes: general food assistance (Food security & agriculture)

definition: Health care delivery and health systems: clinical, public health and pharmacy roles.
includes: primary and secondary care; medical and nursing staff; health systems strengthening; pharmacy and medical supply
note: Counts all health roles, including those also counted under the three specialist health topics below. Do not add them together.

definition: Maternal, newborn and reproductive health services and rights.
includes: maternal and newborn health; family planning; midwifery; SRHR; MISP
excludes: GBV response (Gender-based violence)

definition: Outbreak response and control of communicable diseases.
includes: cholera, Ebola, COVID-19 and other outbreaks; disease surveillance; infection prevention and control; vaccination campaigns; HIV, TB and malaria programmes
standard: IASC Health cluster; WHO outbreak response

definition: Mental health care and psychosocial support for crisis-affected people.
includes: psychologists; psychosocial counsellors; MHPSS coordination
excludes: staff welfare and HR wellbeing roles; "environmental health"

definition: Water supply, sanitation and hygiene promotion.
includes: water engineering; latrines and faecal sludge; hygiene promotion; WASH in institutions

definition: Emergency and transitional shelter, non-food items and settlement planning.
includes: shelter construction and repair; NFI distribution; site planning; housing rehabilitation
excludes: camp management (CCCM); housing, land and property rights (Legal aid, documentation & HLP)
standard: Shelter, Land and Site Coordination cluster (2026; former IASC Shelter cluster)
note: Updated Oct 2026: standard reflects the 2026 cluster consolidation.

definition: Coordination and management of camps and displacement sites.
includes: camp managers; site management; CCCM cluster roles
excludes: shelter construction (Shelter & settlements)
standard: Shelter, Land and Site Coordination cluster (2026; former IASC CCCM cluster)
note: Updated Oct 2026: standard reflects the 2026 cluster consolidation.

definition: Education in emergencies and education programming.
includes: teachers and teacher training; education in emergencies; school construction programmes; education cluster roles
excludes: "education" as a CV requirement; staff training

definition: Restoring incomes and basic infrastructure after a crisis.
includes: income generation; vocational training; cash for work; rehabilitation and reconstruction; economic recovery
excludes: market systems and enterprise development (Markets & value chains); agriculture (Food security & agriculture)
standard: Former IASC Early Recovery cluster (under transformation in the humanitarian reset)
note: Updated Oct 2026: standard updated.

definition: Humanitarian supply chain, common logistics services and emergency telecommunications as a response sector.
includes: Logistics cluster roles; humanitarian supply chain and pipeline management; humanitarian air service (UNHAS); prepositioning; emergency telecommunications (ETC)
excludes: routine logistics, procurement and fleet roles (ReliefWeb career category Logistics/Procurement); generic IT support (ReliefWeb career category ICT)
standard: IASC Logistics and Emergency Telecommunications clusters (merger into one service cluster proposed in the 2025 reset)
note: New topic (Oct 2026). The sector, not the job function: the function comes from the career category.

definition: Protection monitoring, case management and rights-based protection work not covered by the specialist areas below.
includes: protection monitoring; protection case management; protection mainstreaming
excludes: child protection, GBV, mine action, HLP and human rights (own topics); social protection; data protection
note: Updated Oct 2026: human rights and rule of law moved to the new Human rights & humanitarian law topic.

definition: Human rights monitoring and advocacy, international humanitarian law and protection of civilians.
includes: human rights officers; human rights monitoring and reporting; international humanitarian law; protection of civilians; rule of law and transitional justice
excludes: protection monitoring and case management (Protection (general)); "human rights" in an organisation's values statement
note: New topic (Oct 2026). Takes human rights monitoring and rule of law from Protection (general).

definition: Preventing and responding to abuse, neglect, exploitation and violence against children.
includes: unaccompanied and separated children; child protection case management; children associated with armed forces
excludes: child safeguarding policy roles (Safeguarding & PSEA); "unaccompanied" duty stations
standard: IASC Protection cluster (former Child Protection Area of Responsibility, integrated 2026)
note: Updated Oct 2026: standard reflects the 2026 cluster consolidation.

definition: Preventing and responding to gender-based violence.
includes: GBV case management; conflict-related sexual violence; women's protection and empowerment; safe spaces
excludes: gender mainstreaming (Gender equality); PSEA by aid workers (Safeguarding & PSEA)
standard: IASC Protection cluster (former GBV Area of Responsibility, integrated 2026)
note: Updated Oct 2026: standard reflects the 2026 cluster consolidation.

definition: Clearance of mines and explosive ordnance, risk education and victim assistance.
includes: demining; explosive ordnance risk education; weapons contamination; EOD
standard: IASC Protection cluster (former Mine Action Area of Responsibility, integrated 2026)
note: Updated Oct 2026: standard reflects the 2026 cluster consolidation.

definition: Legal assistance, civil documentation and housing, land and property rights.
includes: ICLA; legal counselling; civil documentation and legal identity; birth registration; HLP rights
excludes: digital ID systems (Identity & registration systems); organisational legal counsel
standard: IASC Protection cluster (law and policy); HLP moved to the Shelter, Land and Site Coordination cluster in 2026 (former HLP Area of Responsibility)
note: New topic. Takes "legal identity" from the old Digital identity topic. Updated Oct 2026: HLP now sits with the shelter cluster, legal aid with protection; cross-reference fixed.

definition: Countering trafficking in persons and assisting survivors.
includes: counter-trafficking; victim identification and assistance; modern slavery
excludes: migrant smuggling (Migration); wildlife, drug and arms trafficking
standard: UN Trafficking in Persons Protocol (Palermo); Protection cluster anti-trafficking work
note: Updated Oct 2026: renamed from "Human trafficking & smuggling"; smuggling moved to Migration.

definition: Roles centred on refugees and asylum seekers.
includes: refugee response; refugee status determination; resettlement; asylum procedures
excludes: roles where "refugee" appears only in the organisation's name or mission statement

definition: Roles centred on internally displaced people.
includes: IDP response; displacement tracking (DTM); IDP policy
standard: UN Guiding Principles on Internal Displacement

definition: Roles centred on migrants and mixed movements.
includes: mixed migration; return and reintegration; labour migration; migration policy and data; migrant smuggling
excludes: roles matched only because the employer is IOM
note: Updated Oct 2026: takes migrant smuggling from Human trafficking.

definition: Ending displacement through voluntary return, local integration, or settlement elsewhere, and preventing statelessness.
includes: durable solutions strategies; voluntary return; local integration; statelessness prevention and reduction
excludes: resettlement casework and processing (Refugees & asylum)
standard: IASC Framework on Durable Solutions for IDPs; UNHCR durable solutions and statelessness mandates
note: Updated Oct 2026: definition covers both IDP and refugee solutions; resettlement casework left with Refugees & asylum.

definition: Gender analysis, mainstreaming and women's empowerment.
includes: gender advisers; gender analysis; women's economic empowerment; gender mainstreaming
excludes: GBV (own topic); equal-opportunity statements in ads
standard: IASC Gender Handbook; Gender with Age Marker

definition: Including people with disabilities in programmes and services.
includes: disability inclusion advisers; rehabilitation; inclusive education and accessibility
excludes: equal-opportunity statements; roles matched only because the employer is Humanity & Inclusion
standard: IASC Guidelines on Inclusion of Persons with Disabilities (2019)

definition: Programming for and with young people.
includes: youth empowerment and employment; adolescent programming; youth participation
excludes: "young professional" schemes; internships
standard: UN Youth Strategy; Compact for Young People in Humanitarian Action

definition: Inclusion of older people and LGBTQI+ people, and organisational diversity, equity and inclusion.
includes: older people and ageing; LGBTQI+ inclusion; anti-racism; organisational DEI roles
excludes: equal-opportunity statements; "decolonising aid" and "shift the power" (Localisation & local leadership)
standard: Humanitarian Inclusion Standards for Older People and People with Disabilities

definition: Protecting people from exploitation, abuse and harassment by aid workers and organisations.
includes: safeguarding advisers and investigators; PSEA networks and focal points; child safeguarding
excludes: the standard requirement that every applicant accept the safeguarding policy
standard: IASC PSEA commitments; Core Humanitarian Standard

definition: Listening and answering to affected people, and working to recognised quality standards.
includes: feedback and complaints mechanisms; communicating with communities; community engagement; CHS and Sphere; misinformation and information ecosystems
excludes: financial accountability; parental engagement in schools
standard: IASC AAP commitments; Core Humanitarian Standard; Sphere
replaces: AAP & community engagement; Quality standards (CHS/Sphere); Information integrity

definition: Delivering assistance as cash transfers or vouchers.
includes: cash officers and advisers; CVA programme design; vouchers; cash for work modality; NGO cash coordinators; cash plus and complementary programming; sector-specific cash; targeting and transfer values
excludes: accounting vouchers; cash handling by cashiers and finance staff
note: Parent of MPCA, Cash coordination and Group cash transfers. Do not add them together. Updated Oct 2026: CALP terms added to includes.

definition: Unrestricted cash transfers covering basic needs across sectors.
includes: MPCA; multi-purpose cash; minimum expenditure basket
note: Subset of CVA. Few job titles: read from descriptions.

definition: Inter-agency coordination of cash assistance.
includes: cash working groups; inter-agency cash coordinators; CALP and cash coordination bodies
excludes: NGO internal "Cash Coordinator" roles (CVA); CALP training as a credential
note: Subset of CVA. Thin: chart yearly.

definition: Cash given to community groups or local responders to run their own response projects.
includes: group cash transfers (GCT); community cash grants; microgrants to community groups; survivor- and community-led response
excludes: cash to individual households (CVA, MPCA); grants to registered NGO partners (Partnerships & partner capacity)
note: New topic. Subset of CVA. Expect very few posts: counts only until measured.

definition: Delivering transfers through digital channels and managing payment providers.
includes: mobile money; e-vouchers and e-payments; financial service provider contracting; payment systems; KYC requirements for recipients
excludes: repayments; general finance payments
standard: CALP glossary; Better Than Cash Alliance
note: Few job titles: read from descriptions. Updated Oct 2026: KYC added.

definition: Access to savings, credit and financial services.
includes: VSLAs and savings groups; microfinance; financial literacy; financial inclusion
excludes: service level agreements (SLA)

definition: Market analysis, market systems development and enterprise support.
includes: market assessments (EMMA, MSMA); market systems development; value chains; MSME and enterprise development
excludes: labour market studies; social marketing; subject-matter experts (SME)

definition: Public systems of social assistance (safety nets), social insurance and labour-market support, and their links to humanitarian assistance.
includes: social assistance and safety nets; social insurance; shock-responsive and adaptive social protection; linking humanitarian cash to social protection
excludes: psychosocial assistance; child and legal protection
note: Updated Oct 2026: definition widened beyond safety nets (CALP glossary).

definition: Collecting, analysing and visualising programme data.
includes: data analysts; dashboards and BI; statistics; mobile data collection (Kobo, ODK); Power BI and Tableau
excludes: generic "data analysis" in M&E duties
replaces: Data analytics & BI; Mobile data collection
note: Overlaps ReliefWeb career category "Information Management". Updated Oct 2026: Power BI and Tableau added (old keyword).

definition: Assessing and analysing humanitarian needs to inform response planning.
includes: multi-sector needs assessments (MSNA); JIAF and humanitarian needs overviews; assessment officers and analysts; context and situation analysis
excludes: project baselines and routine M&E (ReliefWeb career category Monitoring and Evaluation); IPC and food security assessments (Food security & agriculture); market assessments (Markets & value chains)
note: New topic (Oct 2026). Overlaps ReliefWeb career category "Information Management". Core only: tagged only when it is the main subject of the role; duties inside other jobs are not counted.

definition: Mapping, geospatial analysis and satellite imagery.
includes: GIS officers; remote sensing; spatial analysis
excludes: stakeholder "mapping"

definition: Systems that register people for assistance and manage their identity records.
includes: beneficiary registration systems (SCOPE, proGres); digital ID; identity management; de-duplication
excludes: civil documentation and legal identity (Legal aid, documentation & HLP); biometric capture itself (Biometrics)
replaces: Digital identity; Registration & beneficiary data systems

definition: Using fingerprints, iris, face or voice to identify the people assisted.
includes: biometric registration and verification; iris and fingerprint systems (e.g. BIMS); biometric policy
excludes: FBI fingerprint checks for applicants; statistical "biometrics" and biometry
note: Very thin in titles (41): counts only.

definition: Making systems and organisations exchange data.
includes: data-sharing agreements and platforms; system integration and APIs; data standards; interoperable registries
excludes: generic "sharing data with colleagues"
note: Almost never in job titles: read from descriptions (duties).

definition: Safe, ethical and lawful management of data about affected people, including data protection.
includes: data protection officers; privacy and data protection impact assessments; data responsibility and data ethics; data governance
excludes: privacy notices to job applicants; IT security (Cybersecurity)
standard: IASC Operational Guidance on Data Responsibility

definition: Securing digital systems and information against attack.
includes: information security; cybersecurity officers; security operations; digital security training
excludes: physical safety and security (Safety & security management)

definition: Using digital technology and innovation to change how organisations and programmes work.
includes: digital strategy; innovation leads, labs and funds; ICT4D; digital inclusion; digital literacy
excludes: generic IT support (ReliefWeb career category ICT)
emerging: digital public infrastructure / digital public goods
note: Updated Oct 2026: digital literacy added (old keyword).

definition: Building or applying artificial intelligence.
includes: machine learning; data science with AI; AI policy and governance
excludes: Amnesty International; French/Spanish "IA" in other senses
replaces: AI & machine learning; Generative AI & LLMs

definition: Distributed ledgers and cryptocurrency.
includes: blockchain; distributed ledger; cryptocurrency; smart contracts
note: Very thin: counts only.

definition: Stablecoins, central bank digital currencies and tokenised money.
includes: stablecoins (USDC, USDT); CBDC; tokenised or virtual assets
excludes: "digital assets" meaning photos and video
note: Very thin: counts only. Old matches were almost all the comms sense of "digital assets"; expect near zero once fixed.

definition: Climate adaptation and finance, environmental sustainability and energy access.
includes: climate adaptation, policy and finance; carbon markets; environmental safeguards and greening; natural resource management; clean energy and energy access
excludes: French "environnement" meaning working environment; "energy" as a personal quality
replaces: Climate; Loss & damage / climate finance; Environmental sustainability; Energy

definition: Reducing disaster risk and preparing for hazards.
includes: DRR; disaster preparedness; early warning systems; contingency planning

definition: Acting on forecasts before a crisis and pre-arranging the money to do so.
includes: anticipatory and forecast-based action; crisis modifiers; disaster risk financing; parametric insurance
excludes: general early warning (DRR & early warning); staff insurance
standard: Anticipation Hub; OCHA anticipatory action frameworks
note: Thin in titles: chart yearly.

definition: Programmes built around strengthening the resilience of people and systems.
includes: resilience programming and building; resilience measurement
excludes: "resilient" as a personal quality

definition: Responding in cities and through settlement or area-based approaches.
includes: urban response; urban planning; area-based coordination
excludes: "rural and urban" as a passing phrase
standard: Global Alliance for Urban Crises; IASC area-based coordination
note: Thin: chart yearly. Updated Oct 2026: moved from "Climate, risk & resilience" to "System & reform".

definition: Shifting power and resources to local and national actors.
includes: localisation; local leadership; shift the power; decolonising aid
excludes: software and language localisation; "localisation du poste" (job location)
note: Also takes "decolonisation" and "shift the power" from the old DEI topic.

definition: Building, brokering and managing partnerships with other organisations, and strengthening the organisational capacity of those partners.
includes: partnership managers, advisers and officers; identifying, selecting and contracting partners; partnership agreements and partner due diligence; managing partner relationships and sub-grantee portfolios as a named responsibility; organisational capacity assessment and strengthening of partner organisations
excludes: training or capacity building of own staff, beneficiaries, communities or government officials; "capacity building" as a generic skill or duty; "coordinate, liaise or work with partners and stakeholders"; routine oversight of a sub-grant or implementing partner inside a project; donor relations and fundraising; consortium or inter-agency coordination (Humanitarian coordination)
note: Descriptions unreliable (2 of 20 genuine): use titles. Updated Oct 2026: renamed from "Partnerships & capacity strengthening" and narrowed to partnership building and partner capacity. Core only: tagged only when partnerships are the main subject of the role; partnership duties inside other jobs are not counted.

definition: Joining up humanitarian, development and peace work.
includes: nexus advisers; HDP nexus; triple nexus
excludes: water-energy-food nexus; "nexus" as a product or project name
standard: OECD DAC Recommendation on the HDP Nexus

definition: Building peace and making aid sensitive to conflict.
includes: peacebuilding; social cohesion; conflict analysis; conflict sensitivity; peacekeeping support; DDR; security sector reform
excludes: "do no harm" as a stock principle; "conflict resolution" as a soft skill
note: Updated Oct 2026: peacekeeping, DDR and SSR added to match the ReliefWeb theme.

definition: Running the coordination system between agencies.
includes: cluster and sector coordinators; OCHA coordination roles; inter-agency and HCT support
excludes: cash coordination and CCCM (own topics); NGO roles titled "Humanitarian Coordinator"

definition: Reform of the humanitarian system.
includes: humanitarian reset; Grand Bargain; UN80 and efficiency reforms
note: Emerging: counts only.

definition: Negotiating access and working alongside military actors.
includes: access advisers; access negotiation; CMCoord
excludes: access to services; database access
note: Updated Oct 2026: moved from "Operations & assurance" to "System & reform".

definition: Internal controls, fraud prevention, audit and organisational risk.
includes: compliance officers; anti-fraud and investigations; internal audit; enterprise risk; counter-terrorism and sanctions compliance; AML/CFT and de-risking
excludes: the standard requirement to follow the fraud policy; disaster and security risk
note: Specialist function not covered by ReliefWeb career categories. Updated Oct 2026: AML/CFT and de-risking added. Core only: tagged only when it is the main subject of the role; duties inside other jobs are not counted.

definition: Keeping staff and operations safe.
includes: security managers and advisers; security risk management; security focal points as the role
excludes: food, livelihood and social security; "report to the security focal point"
note: Core only: tagged only when it is the main subject of the role; duties inside other jobs are not counted.

definition: Monitoring carried out by a contracted third party or at a distance.
includes: third-party monitoring; remote monitoring; field monitors for TPM firms

definition: Rigorous evaluation and research roles.
includes: impact evaluations; RCTs; research leads and principal investigators
excludes: routine M&E (ReliefWeb career category Monitoring and Evaluation)
